payload.summary: Greptile on PR #110 (MAR-3007): a new validation output list needs its reporting ceiling documented under Bounds and test coverage alongside truncated blocking issues.
lessons: When validation output gains another bounded list, update the contract Bounds row and truncation paragraph to state whether the 100-issue ceiling is shared or per list.
Options that reclassify validation issues must be tested with more than 100 issues mixed with a blocking error, proving the blocking issue survives and each list carries its own truncation marker.
